name: Hot soy milk
summary: Sweet hot soy milk for a cool Da Lat evening, carried in a cup from the market.
origin: An evening drink at the Da Lat market and the night market. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names it for the cool air.
howToEat: Take a cup after dark, when the air cools, and walk with it.

Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 10,000 VND at 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ and says that counter also sells other soy milks, without naming them. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism does not print a stall price.
where: Da Lat Market and the night market in the centre. The food-tour note names 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ. Visit Lâm Đồng puts the night stalls at about 18:00–23:00.
priceBand: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 10,000 VND at 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism prints no stall price.
seoTitle: Hot soy milk — Da Lat night market
seoDescription: Sữa đậu nành nóng at the Da Lat market after dark. A food-tour note prints 10,000 VND at 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ.
